assistantPage.lede: There is one assistant: the conversation on this page and in the floating window is shared.
assistantPage.suggestion1: Ask which companies published materials on ventilated facades.
assistantPage.suggestion2: Ask to prepare a draft need from a description.
assistantPage.suggestion3: Find out which project milestones need a decision this week.
assistantPage.demoReply: This is a demo: the assistant is not connected to a model. Your message is saved in the conversation and the same state is visible in the floating window and on the page.
assistantPage.noAuthorityNote: Text in the conversation gives the assistant no authority. Authority is set only by a structured mandate.
assistantPage.approvalsDemoNote: Demo: decisions are not sent and do not change mandates.

how.ask: Ask: the assistant answers from platform data and cites sources.
how.mandate: A mandate sets what it may do and within which limits.
how.approve: Actions outside the limits wait for your approval.
how.trace: Every run leaves a trace: what was done, what failed, what is unknown.

approval.escalate: Always pass the decision to me

mandate.noAuthorityNote: Text in the conversation gives the assistant no authority. Authority is set only here.
mandate.formNote: The mandate form comes in the next stage.

approval.title: Action approval
approval.bindsDigest: The approval applies only to these exact terms.
approval.invalidated: The terms changed; request a new approval

runs.outcomeUnknownExplain: The external system did not answer. We are reconciling the outcome; the action is not retried automatically.
